  "durationHours": 14,
  "level": "INTERMEDIATE",

exec: pm.test("Price and duration updated", function () { pm.expect(json.price).to.eql(59.99); pm.expect(json.durationHours).to.eql(14); });
pm.test("Our course is found", function () { const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("courseId")); pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(c => c.id === id)).to.be.true; });

item.name: Q1b Search with a budget too low (empty result)

exec: pm.test("Course is filtered out by price", function () { const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("courseId")); pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(c => c.id === id)).to.be.false; });

item.name: Q2 Class roster of a course

exec: pm.test("Roster contains our student", function () { const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("studentId")); pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(s => s.id === id)).to.be.true; });

pm.test("Ranking is sorted, biggest first", function () { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; for (let i = 1; i < r.length; i++) { pm.expect(r[i-1].enrollments).to.be.at.least(r[i].enrollments); } });
pm.test("Revenue = price of the one enrollment", function () { pm.expect(Number(json.totalRevenue)).to.eql(59.99); });
pm.test("1 review, average 4", function () { pm.expect(json.reviewCount).to.eql(1); pm.expect(json.averageRating).to.eql(4); });
